name: Exact recertification after finite N=1 observation-row chart optimization

statement.latest: \mathcal R_*\in\arg\min_{\mathcal R\in\mathfrak R_{N=1}}\widetilde S(\mathcal R),\qquad J_{\mathcal R_*}(x_*)\text{ re-inverted exactly over }\mathbb Q,\qquad r_{\mathcal R_*}=\frac{1}{2S(\mathcal R_*)}>r_{\mathcal R_0}
statement.note_ascii: within the structurally minimal N=1 shell-energy Taylor chart family (three order-zero rows and two of three shell rows at each order 1..23), a deterministic floating search is used only to choose a candidate; the final selected chart is then independently rechecked at rank 49 and re-inverted exactly over Q, and its componentwise local radius is rigorously larger than the previous first-independent chart radius

definitions.mathfrak_R_N1: finite family of structurally minimal 49-observation shell-energy Taylor charts: all three shell rows at order 0 and one of three shell-row pairs at each order 1..23
definitions.R_*: deterministically selected candidate chart from six declared search starts
definitions.S(R): exact post-selection preconditioned componentwise Jacobian-variation slope max_i sum_j |(J_R(x_*)^{-1})_ij| H_j

parents.evidence: the candidate chart is evaluated with the same exact coefficient-tensor Hessian bounds and exact rational inverse machinery
row choice is shown not to be the dominant remaining obstruction: the exact radius improves but remains in the same 10^-28 to 10^-27 power-of-ten bracket

claim_boundary: Fixed finite N=1 chart-selection result only. Floating arithmetic is used solely as a search heuristic; the accepted chart is exactly re-certified. The result does not establish global optimality over all possible readers, a measurement-ready tolerance, branch/noise stability, arbitrary-N inversion, all-N saturation, continuum regularity or singularity, physical DNS adequacy, or the Clay result.
